feature_drift.notes: PSI thresholds: LOW (<0.10), MODERATE (0.10-0.25), HIGH (>=0.25). Arbitrary thresholds do not prove model degradation.

prediction_drift.scientific_distinction: Prediction drift measures shifts in model outputs P(Y_hat). It must not be conflated with true concept drift P(Y|X), which requires ground-truth label changes.

graph_drift.snapshot_43_caveat: Snapshot 43 documents severe structural network reorganization (in-degree drops, elevated zero-incoming-edge proportion). External Darknet market takedown hypotheses remain non-causal observational context, not verified causal drivers.
